goldenConventions: Structural only. The container is always a <div class="pa-checkbox-group ..."> in both wrappers. The body slot is a plain text token. A layout modifier is present when a layout is set; the default column has no class. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.
